results.content:
Title: Microsoft Xbox Series S: Next-gen Performance in the smallest Xbox ever | Product Hunt
# Microsoft Xbox Series S. ## Next-gen Performance in the smallest Xbox ever. The next generation of gaming brings our largest digital library yet to our smallest Xbox ever. With more dynamic worlds, faster load times, and the addition of Xbox Game Pass (sold separately), the all-digital Xbox Series S is the best value in gaming. This is the 2nd launch from Microsoft Xbox Series S. ## XBOX Nano Controller. Pocket-sized wireless gamepad with all 18 inputs. Take play to more places with the XBOX Nano Controller. Fit more play in your everyday in a smaller form factor. Connect via Bluetooth & play across devices. Launch tags:XBox•Hardware•Games. Dropbox SignSimple, secure eSignatures for the way your team works. ## PreviousMicrosoft Xbox Series SLaunches. Xbox Series SNext-gen performance in the smallest Xbox ever. Launched on September 9th, 2020. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Microsoft Xbox Series S. Xbox has squeezed its full controller layout into something smaller than most phones. The Nano is just over 5 inches long, weighs 3.5 ounces, and still has all 18 standard gameplay inputs. It connects to Xbox consoles with Xbox Wireless, or to PCs, phones and compatible TVs over Bluetooth. There's a rechargeable battery and a programmable Action Button too. I can see this being handy for smaller hands, a second controller for local co-op, or just throwing in a bag for gaming on the go. It's $49.99, with pre-orders open now and shipping in November. Not exactly nano pricing with so many cheaper mini controllers around, but native Xbox Wireless support is a nice advantage!
